title: Register Google OAuth clients for each environment
description:
**Phase 1 of 7.** First link in the critical path. Human action, not code, so start it even if nothing else starts.

- **Blocked by:** nothing, start today
- **Runs in parallel with:** 79ca6a, 7c1382, 272aea, 1ebc7d
- **Unblocks:** 0df6cb

---
One Google Cloud project, an OAuth consent screen, and one OAuth client per environment. Redirect URIs point at the Cognito custom auth domain, not at the app.

Client secrets go straight into Secrets Manager at chatticus/{environment}/oauth/google. They never enter the repository, a CDK template, or an agent transcript. The pudicus pre-commit gate is the backstop, not the plan.

**Done when:** three clients exist and their ids and secrets are in Secrets Manager.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
**Architect ruling: consent screen and ownership.**

- **External, not Internal.** Internal restricts sign-in to the Workspace, which contradicts the entire waitlist premise. We are deliberately admitting people outside endymion.com.
- **Owned by the AnthusAI organization account**, not a personal Google account. A personal-account OAuth client is a single point of failure we would have to migrate later.
- **Scopes limited to `openid email profile`.** Anything more drags us into Google's restricted-scope review, which is a different and much slower process. We need a verified email and nothing else.

**Read ac5453 before you finish.** An unverified External app is capped at 100 users and shows a warning on the consent screen, and verification requires a privacy policy on the marketing site. That is a dependency on marketing, and it is on the path to public signup even though it is not on the path to development working.
